tax_name: Goods and Services Tax / Harmonized Sales Tax (GST/HST)
legal_ref: Excise Tax Act (R.S.C. 1985, c. E-15) s.165(1), as replaced by S.C. 2007, c. 35, s.184
quote: "every recipient of a taxable supply made in Canada shall pay to Her Majesty in right of Canada tax in respect of the supply calculated at the rate of 5% on the value of the consideration for the supply" (ETA s.165(1)); S.C. 2007 c.35 s.184(2): "Subsection (1) applies (a) to any supply ... made on or after January 1, 2008"
source_title: Excise Tax Act s.165 (Justice Laws Website); commencement from Budget and Economic Statement Implementation Act, 2007 (S.C. 2007, c. 35) s.184, laws-lois.justice.gc.ca/eng/AnnualStatutes/2007_35/FullText.html
notes: Federal GST 5%. ETA s.165(2) adds a provincial component in 'participating provinces' (HST). Combined HST per CRA rate table (canada.ca, modified 2025-04-01): Ontario 13%; New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Prince Edward Island 15%; Nova Scotia 14% ('As of April 1, 2025, the HST rate has decreased to 14% in Nova Scotia'). GST-only 5% in AB, BC, MB, QC, SK, NT, NU, YT; separate provincial sales taxes: BC PST 7%, MB RST 7%, SK PST 6%, Quebec QST 9.975%. Zero-rated supplies taxed at 0% (ETA s.165(3)), e.g. exports. Small-supplier registration threshold: CAD 30,000 over four consecutive calendar quarters (canada.ca).
